fichas.h1_agente: Hermes Maxi Leather King Bed by DV Home Collection
fichas.h1_seo: Hermes Maxi Upholstered King Bed by DV Home Collection
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Hermes bed is a king bed by DV Home Collection, with an upholstered multilayer structure over non-deformable polyurethane foam and a super-wide headboard with vertical quilting. Made in Italy.

UPHOLSTERY OPTIONS

The upholstery comes in a wide range of fabric or leather options, so you can pick the cover on this Maxi bed without changing the structure.

QUILTING AND CUSHIONS

The quilted headboard stands 63" high. Goose feather square decorative cushions, 19 5/8" or 15 3/4", are available upon request.

The frame measures 149 5/8" W x 87 3/4" D and takes an American king mattress of 76 3/4" x 80" D. See our double beds for other upholstered frames.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
The Hermes bed frame pairs a low upholstered base with an extra-wide headboard in vertical quilting. The "Maxi" is the wide version of the Hermes Bed: the headboard runs well past the sides of the mattress.
BEFORE YOU ORDER
 It fits a standard American King mattress (76 3/4" × 80"). Slats are included and the mattress is not. Measure the wall first: this maxi bed is much wider than the mattress.
UPHOLSTERY
 Fabrics from the Lario, Lido, Cloud and Vegan Nabuk lines, or leather in categories A, B and C. Square goose feather cushions (19 5/8" or 15 3/4") are available on request.

fichas.h1_agente: Tiffany Gold Leaf Wall Mirror by DV Home Collection
fichas.h1_seo: Tiffany Large Rectangular Wall Mirror by DV Home Collection
fichas.descripcion_agente:
This tiffany style mirror by DV Home Collection has a multilayered structure and a 1/8"-thick natural mirror. It is rectangular, wall-mounted and framed in metal. Made in Italy.

SIX FRAME FINISHES

  • Shining stainless steel
  • Antique bronze satin
  • Shaded glossy or shaded satin
  • Chrome black
  • 24Kt gold dip

Every version carries the same mirrored surface, so the choice is finish only. It hangs vertically: at 47 1/4" W x 55 1/8" D you need a tall stretch of wall. See all mirrors in Accessories.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
The Tiffany mirror is a rectangular wall mirror with a slim metal frame and natural mirror glass, 1/8" thick. Made in Italy.
VERTICAL OR HORIZONTAL
 You can hang it upright, or turn it sideways over a console or a sideboard. For a taller, narrower mirror, see the Tiffany Extra Large.
FRAME FINISHES
 Stainless steel, antique bronze satin, shaded glossy, shaded satin, chrome black, 24kt gold, champagne gold, pink gold or gold satin.

fichas.h1_agente: Cleopatra Leather Dining Chair by OAK
fichas.h1_seo: Cleopatra Wood and Leather Dining Chair by OAK
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Cleopatra chair wood frame has leather upholstery; this OAK dining chair is designed by Luca Scacchetti.

DESIGN AND FINISHES

Luca Scacchetti's Cleopatra chair design is armless, with a high backrest and legs. Finish options are Rosewood, Ebony or Citronier.

SIZE AND PLACEMENT

At 18 1/8" W and 26 3/8" D, it fits narrow dining layouts; check the depth against your table clearance before ordering. See all dining chairs.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
Designed by Luca Scacchetti, Cleopatra's chair is a wood and leather chair for the dining room. It has a tall backrest that stands out around the table.
WOOD
 This Cleopatra wooden chair comes in amara ebony, or lacquered in black, ivory, lead grey, red or white. Each option has a satin or a polished finish.
LEATHER
 Smooth leather in categories A to C, waxed leather or nabuk, including a nabuk with a Kuba pattern.

fichas.h1_seo: Club Sofa with Brass Tube Frame by Rugiano
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Club is a Rugiano sofa built on a structure of brushed brass or bronze drawn tubes, combined with fabric or leather upholstery. Made in Italy.

FRAME AND UPHOLSTERY

Every version of the club style sofa keeps the brushed brass or bronze tubes, so the choice is the cover: fabric or leather.

FOUR WIDTHS

The club couch comes in four widths, from 62 3/8" W to 122" W, all at 33 1/2" D and 28" H. Pick by the length of your wall; browse all sofas and sectionals.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
A club style sofa with straight lines and a frame of brushed brass or bronze tubes that outline the upholstery. If you are comparing Rugiano sofas, this is the one where the metal frame is the design.
FITS MORE ROOMS THAN IT LOOKS
 At 33 1/2" deep, this club couch is shallower than most luxury sofas. That makes it a good choice for apartments and narrow living rooms. It comes in four widths, from a 2-seater to the 4-seater Major.
UPHOLSTERY
 Fabric (categories A and B) or leather (C and D). You can also send your own fabric or leather (C.O.M. / C.O.L.).

fichas.h1_agente: Rock Marble Coffee Table by Rugiano
fichas.h1_seo: Rock Marble Coffee Table by Rugiano
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Rugiano coffee table Rock has a shaped top in Decoro decorated painted wood or in one of the marble options, on two bronzed brass legs. Made in Italy.

TOP OPTIONS

The marble coffee table top comes in a wide range of options; the alternative is Decoro decorated painted wood.

FOUR SIZES

The four tops run from 20" W x 21 5/8" D x 14 1/8" H to 71 1/4" W x 42 1/8" D x 11" H. Compare the footprints with the other coffee tables in the category.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
The Rock is a Rugiano coffee table with an irregular, pebble-like top resting on two bronzed brass legs. Made in Italy.
TWO TOPS, TWO LOOKS
 • Marble table top in 19 marbles, from Travertino and Emperador Dark (category A) to Calacatta Gold (B) and Patagonia or Calcite St Barth (C).
 • A hand-painted wood table top in Rugiano's Decoro technique, with 11 designs inspired by painters such as Van Gogh, Monet and Botticelli.
WHICH SIZE
 The three large sizes are 11" high, for a low sofa. The small one (size C) is 14 1/8" high and works as a side table next to an armchair.

fichas.h1_agente: Cruise Fabric Outdoor Sofa by Talenti
fichas.h1_seo: Cruise Teak Outdoor Sofa by Talenti
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Cruise is a three-seater outdoor sofa designed by Ludovica + Roberto Palomba for Talenti. This Talenti sofa has a structure entirely in teak wood, with synthetic rope on the armrests and backrest. Made in Italy.

TEAK AND ROPE

The structure is entirely in teak wood. Synthetic rope is reserved for the armrests and backrest, and the seat and back cushions are covered in weather-resistant fabric.

MEASURE BEFORE YOU BUY

At 96 3/8" W and 43 1/4" D, it takes a wide terrace; the seat sits at 14 5/8" and the armrest at 24 3/4". Compare it with other outdoor sofas if your space is narrower.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
The Cruise couch is a three-seater outdoor sofa by Ludovica + Roberto Palomba for Talenti. It has a full teak frame, with woven synthetic rope on the arms and backrest, like the deck of a boat.
MADE TO STAY OUTSIDE
 • Smoke teak frame.
 • Quick-dry foam padding.
 • Removable cushion covers in weather-resistant, fire-rated outdoor fabrics (Mambo Taupe, Twill Beige, Slate Grey).
A LOW, RELAXED SEAT
 The seat is 14 5/8" high, lower than an indoor sofa, for lounging by the pool or on a terrace. Extra decorative cushions are optional.

fichas.h1_agente: Bakkarat Glass Dining Table by Tonelli Design
fichas.h1_seo: Bakkarat Round Glass Dining Table by Tonelli Design
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Bakkarat is a glass dining table by Tonelli Design, designed by D'Urbino e Lomazzi. Round extra clear glass top and sculptural central leg on a chrome-plated metal base. Made in Italy.

GLASS AND BASE

The round top and the sculptural central leg are extra clear glass, resting on a chrome-plated metal base.

CHOOSING THE DIAMETER

  • Ø43 1/4" x 29 1/2" H
  • Ø47 1/4" x 29 1/2" H
  • Ø51 1/8" x 29 1/2" H
  • Ø55 1/8" x 29 1/2" H

All four sizes are 29 1/2" high, so the diameter sets the footprint. For more glass dining tables, see the fixed tables category.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
A round dining table in glass by D'Urbino e Lomazzi for Tonelli. The top is extra clear tempered glass. The sculptural central leg is a 1 1/8" thick glass piece on a polished chrome base. Made in Italy.
WHY EXTRA CLEAR GLASS
 Standard glass shows a green tint at the edges. Extra clear glass stays colorless, so this glass table lets you see the twist of the leg from every side of the room.
FOUR DIAMETERS
 From 43 1/4" to 55 1/8", all at standard dining height.

fichas.h1_agente: Illan Wood Wall Sconce by Luceplan
fichas.h1_seo: Illan LED Wall Sconce by Luceplan
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Luceplan Illan wall sconce is designed by Zsuzsanna Horvath, with a laser-cut layered wood shade on a die-cast aluminum body. The Illan lamp uses surplus wood left over from producing the Illan suspension lamp. Made in Italy.

LIGHT AND DIMMING

  • LED 21W, 1265 lm, CRI 90.
  • 2700K or 3000K.
  • Dimmable, UL Approved.

At 11" W x 5 1/8" D x 11" H it stays close to the wall and sends the light upward, so it suits a hallway or a bedside. For more options, browse our wall sconces.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
Luceplan Illan is an LED wall sconce designed by Zsuzsanna Horvath. Its shade is laser-cut birch wood in thin layers, made from the material left over when producing the Illan suspension lamp.
THE LIGHT
 • LED 21W, 1265 lumens, CRI 90.
 • Dimmable, in 2700K (warmer) or 3000K.
 • The light points upward, so this wall light washes the wall without glare.
 • UL approved.
WHERE IT WORKS
 At 11" wide and only 5 1/8" deep, it fits hallways and both sides of a bed.

fichas.h1_agente: Steinway Piano by Riva Mobili D'Arte
fichas.h1_seo: Hand-Carved Mother-of-Pearl Steinway Piano by Riva Mobili D'Arte
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The 19800 Steinway Piano by Riva Mobili D'Arte is a piano with a real mother-of-pearl finish and a solid wood base carved in three dimensions. Made in Italy.

MOTHER-OF-PEARL AND INLAYS

Precious wood and brass inlays sit under a deep high-gloss coating. The mother-of-pearl is naturally iridescent, so its color shifts with the light.

CARVING AND GOLD LEAF

The hand-carved base and sides are finished in hand-applied gold leaf, sealed with a high-gloss coating.

Since the carvings cover the sides too, place it where more than one face stays visible. It measures ~74 5/8" W x ~59" D x ~43 1/4" H. Find more pianos in the accessories category.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
Among Steinway and Sons pianos, this is a one-of-a-kind dressed piece. Riva Mobili d'Arte covers it in mother-of-pearl, with inlays of precious wood and brass and a deep high-gloss finish. The result is an Italian piano case made to be the centerpiece of a room.
CRAFT
 A solid wood base, hand-carved in three dimensions and finished in hand-applied gold leaf. The mother-of-pearl changes color with the angle of light. A matching ottoman is included.
MATCHING PIECES
 The same finish is available on sofas, lounge chairs, consoles and mirrors from the collection.

fichas.h1_seo: Shibari Stretch Fabric Armchair by Visionnaire
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Shibari is a Visionnaire armchair designed by Studiopepe, fully covered in stretch fabric so the silhouette reads as one continuous shape. Curved tubular metal legs meet at the backrest in a fluid knot.

THE KNOT

The knot gives Shibari chairs their name and stands for a bond, not a restraint. A high-density polyurethane core and a webbed seat keep the armchair supportive.

SIZE AND FRAME

At 23 5/8" W x 27 1/2" D x 30 3/8" H, it fits a dining room, with armrests, a regular backrest and a metal frame. Browse our chairs and armchairs to compare sizes and covers.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
A Visionnaire chair designed by Studiopepe. Curved metal tubes run from the legs to the backrest, where they close in a soft knot, the idea behind the name.
UPHOLSTERY
 Fully covered in recycled stretch fabric (Paddington) in Chalk, Carbon, Natural, Amaretto or Gris, with a backrest cushion included. Like all Shibari chairs, it has a high-density foam core and a webbed seat.
